function.name: submitCallback
function.description: Log a callback request when you can't fully help the caller live (price questions you won't quote, Spanish callers needing a Spanish-speaking team member, angry callers needing a manager, after-hours requests, anything escalatory). Collect name + phone + reason at minimum, then call this. Tell the caller the shop will follow up — do NOT promise a specific time.

phone.description: Best phone number to reach the caller back. Required.

reason.description: Short reason for the callback (e.g. 'wants pricing for full brake job', 'Spanish speaker', 'wants to dispute a previous repair'). Optional but recommended.

urgency.description: 'urgent' for safety / dispute / angry-caller scenarios; otherwise 'normal'.

preferredTime.description: When they'd prefer to be called back. Free-form text. Optional.

language.description: Language they speak (e.g. 'english', 'spanish', 'arabic'). Optional · defaults to english.
